details: The tension slider fires a full canvas redraw (`drawEdges()`) on every `input` event without debouncing or `requestAnimationFrame` coalescing, creating an update storm at ~60fps during drag; hover (`pointerenter`) also synchronously sweeps all ~120 SVG leaf nodes to update circle radii, fills, and text attributes, but fires only once per node entry so is less severe. No transitions are used (no handoff race), pointer events unify mouse/touch correctly, and mutable closure variables (`currentBeta`, `hoveredNode`) are always read at call time so no stale scale issue exists.
